title: Uniform local models and Tor interval for a twisted coefficient dual
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $T$ a scheme. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale site and its derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $a\leq b$ and $m$ be integers, and let $P\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ admit an etale covering on which it is represented by bounded complexes $E^\bullet$ of constant finite projective $A$-modules zero outside $[a,b]$. Here finite projective means a direct summand of a finite free module. Let $L$ be a module sheaf etale locally isomorphic to $A_T$, and put $H=R\mathcal Hom_A(P,L[m])$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then, on a common refinement trivializing $L$, $H$ is represented by $\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(E^\bullet,A)[m]$, with degree-$q$ dual term $\operatorname{Hom}_A(E^{-q},A)$ and differential $d^q(\phi)=(-1)^{q+1}\phi d_E^{-q-1}$ before shifting. Its terms are constant finite projective modules and are zero outside $[-b-m,-a-m]$. In particular $H$ has finite locally constant cohomology, is bounded constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and has Tor amplitude in $[-b-m,-a-m]$: $\mathcal H^i(H\otimes_A^L M)=0$ outside this interval for every degree-zero module sheaf $M$ [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-kun-tor-amplitude].
